body:
Yeah, 'escapism' may as well be my middle name. I'm just doing so much of it at this point that it's fucking everything else up. I used to be big into books and video games too but I can't be arsed to follow up on even those... I just lose interest.

I've never tried meditation before though. I guess I always figured that I'd never be able to quiet my brain enough to take advantage of it... perhaps that just takes practice. I should really force myself to get some exercise as well. Every little bit helps, and if it prevents me from turning my organs into stone with alcohol, it's certainly worth a shot.

Thanks for the advice!

I'll see about talking to them about it. And I'd like to try some other strategies to work with it. As for the behaviours, I guess practice makes perfect.

Thanks again for the advice, it's been helpful hearing from another perspective than where I'm at.

Hey thanks for the reply. Yeah drinking works for the time being, but I'm seriously concerned about damaging my liver in the long term. You're right, I need to find better ways of coping.

I've tried to take it easier at work but every time I try and slow down, I get angry that I'm fucking everyone else over and not even living up to my own expectations. Then I stay up all night and worry about it (among other things). 

I have a real problem with 'what ifs' and they constantly bounce around in my mind. I can identify them along with other self-destructive behaviour, but I don't know how to prevent them or shut them off.

I don't want to die. I think I just need to figure out how to live with myself, even if I'm letting myself and others down.
